description: 1.5MHz Step-down type Adjustable 2A SOT-23-5 Voltage Regulators - DC DC Switching Regulators

provenance.pins: datasheet p.2 Pin Description table (SOT-23-5). vMax values are from the Absolute Maximum Ratings table, not from the pin table.

notes: the SY8089 is sized against the ESP32-C6's 382 mA worst-case TX peak (datasheet Table 13, 802.11b at 20.5 dBm), not the ~500 mA a module-level figure suggests - that figure is IVDD, the minimum current the external supply must be able to deliver, a different quantity. An LDO would burn ~0.6 W, not 0.8 W.
Input range 2.5-5.5 V, which suits the 4.56-5.00 V rail it runs from.
designVerdict: SELECTED - 5 V rail to the 3.3 V rail

rules.note: datasheet: 'Do not leave it floating'. R30, 100 kOhm to the input.
input ceramic required at the pin; C12.
